verdict.rationale: ReelMimic's own reference analysis extracts camera moves along with framing and shots, so motion follows a creator-chosen reference rather than the model's whim. Creators can also adjust the storyboard plan before approval and request changes via chat or timestamped comments, though none of the evidence ties these specifically to camera direction. missing for 10: an explicit control for specifying pan/zoom/orbit/static per shot, documentation that camera-move edits via chat or storyboard are honored, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
